description: This file defines a PHP class 'DB' in the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library\Session' that manages session data stored in a database table. It provides methods for reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session records.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Handles session data persistence in a database table for the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB object with references to the database and configuration components.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data for a given session ID if it exists and hasn't expired.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data associated with a session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data for a specific session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions based on random chance dictated by configuration.
